pretreatment: In situ plasma oxidation process to form a very thin SiO2 layer before the Al2O3 growth
evidence: In order to deposit high quality silicate films, a deposition method producing reactive species is needed. The PEALD method enhances the reactivity between the adsorbed precursor molecules and reactant gas due to the activation of reactant gas molecules by the rf plasma. For the deposition of high k materials, more dense films with superb electrical properties can be obtained using PEALD. In our present paper, aluminum silicate (AlSixOy) films were deposited on p-type Si (100) substrates by PEALD using TMA and tetraethoxysilane (TEOS) as Al and Si precursors, respectively.
